part.text:
Fixed. In routergroup.go:198, when a static file isn't found the handler reset `c.handlers` to `engine.allNoRoute` (global middleware + NoRoute handlers) and rewound `c.index`, so `Context.Next()` re-executed the middleware chain — causing the duplicate log line with `gin.Default()` + `StaticFS`. Changed it to `engine.noRoute` so only the NoRoute handlers run, since middleware already executed in the static chain.

Verified: `TestMiddlewareCalledOnceByRouterStaticFSNotFound` (the #1805 reproduction), `TestRouterStaticFSNotFound`, and the full test suite all pass.
